::: {.callout-note}
## Category Overview & Scope
이 섹션은 딥러닝 태동 이전부터 발전해 온 수학적·기하학적 컴퓨터비전 기본 원리를 다룹니다.

* **Image Filtering & Edge Detection:** Spatial Convolution, Sobel, Laplacian of Gaussian (LoG), Canny Edge Detector
* **Feature Extraction & Matching:** Harris Corner Detector, SIFT, SURF, ORB, RANSAC
* **Camera Geometry & Calibration:** Pinhole Camera Model, Intrinsic/Extrinsic Parameters, Lens Distortion
* **Multiple View Geometry:** Epipolar Geometry, Essential & Fundamental Matrix, Triangulation, Stereo Vision
:::
